panels.title: Phase G.37 Staging Operational Summary & Disclaimer

options.content:
### AIOps Staging Operational Telemetry Monitoring (UPS & PAC)
- **Scope:** Isolated staging dashboard for `ME_UPS1`–`ME_UPS3` and `ME_PAC1`–`ME_PAC4`.
- **Objective:** Anomaly detection and sensor health monitoring using Robust Z-score (MAD threshold 3.5) and Isolation Forest.
- **Important Operational Disclaimer:** Detected anomalies represent statistical deviations from baseline telemetry patterns and **do NOT** automatically imply physical equipment failure or Remaining Useful Life (RUL) expiration.
- **Production Safety:** 0 production changes, 0 service restarts, 0 Zabbix write operations.

panels.title: UPS Output Load & Battery Voltage Trends (Staging)

SELECT timestamp as time, host, observed_value as value FROM staging_anomalies_detected WHERE host LIKE 'ME_PAC%'
